## Type of change

<!-- Put an `x` in the boxes that apply. -->

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (so `git-cliff` can build the changelog).
- [ ] `task ci` passes locally (tidy check + lint + build + test).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for my change.
- [ ] I updated the documentation (README / godoc / `AGENTS.md`) where relevant.
- [ ] I kept the change compatible with the supported Go floor (1.18+).
